539-2438-3821-4679-6023.easyPrerequisites: You control at least two lands excluding Yenna that can tap for mana.
539-2438-3821-4679-6023.description:
Activate up to four lands excluding Yenna by tapping them, adding at least {2}
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Peregrine Drake
When the Peregrine Drake token enters, it triggers, untapping Yenna and up to four other lands.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the Peregrine Drake token, putting a +1/+1 counter on Carrion Feeder.
Repeat

512-1432-4137.easyPrerequisites: Blossom-Clad Werewolf and Ioreth of the Healing House do not have summoning sickness.
512-1432-4137.description:
Activate Blossom-Clad Werewolf by tapping it, adding {W}{W}
Activate Ioreth of the Healing House by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Ioreth of the Healing House and Blossom-Clad Werewolf, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Ioreth of the Healing House ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

678-4063-5670--52.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
678-4063-5670--52.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
When the creature dies, Fleshtaker and Enduring Renewal trigger.
Resolve the Fleshtaker trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and scry 1
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

856-4247-5776-7422.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Garrison Excavator trigger.
Resolve the Garrison Excavator trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

3678-7084-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Retreat to Emeria triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and The Wandering Minstrel.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2

7414-7737.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
7414-7737.description:
Draw a card.
Stark's Ingenuity triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Pensive Professor.
Pensive Professor triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

193-2724-4450-6432.description:
Activate Aminatou by putting 0 loyalty counter on them due to Carth the Lion, blinking Wormfang Manta.
When Wormfang Manta leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Wormfang Manta entering does not cause its abillity to trigger due to Doorkeeper Thrull.
Repeat each turn.

2366-4178-5434-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
You control a Forest that does not have summoning sickness and that enters the battlefield untapped.
2366-4178-5434-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Nissa, Who Shakes the World triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.
Activate Nissa's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, animating a Forest you control.
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Activate the animated Forest by tapping it, adding {G}.
Nissa triggers, adding {G}.
Play a land.
When the land enters the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of the Forest it is attached to.
When the Forest token enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers.
Holding priority, activate the Forest token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Nissa triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of the Forest it is attached to.
Repeat from step 6.

1170-1329-4708-5434.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Dark Sphere from your graveyard.
Cast Dark Sphere by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Dark Sphere by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

2724-3194-7334.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill The Neutrinos.
2724-3194-7334.description:
Blink Wormfang Manta using The Neutrinos. Wormfang Manta's first ability won't trigger due to Hushwing Gryff.
Wormfang Manta's second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

uses.n: Kirol, History Buff // Pack a Punch

1402-7547-7548--85.description:
Activate Diamond Lion by tapping it, discarding your hand, and sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}{R} or {W}{W}{W}.
Cast a copy of Pack a Punch from exile by paying {1}{W}{R}, unpreparing Kirol.
When you cast that spell, Forum Necroscribe triggers, returning Diamond Lion from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Diamond Lion leaves your graveyard, Kirol triggers, becoming prepared.
Pack a Punch resolves, causing you to mill a card, put two +1/+1 counters onto its target, and give it trample until end of turn.
Repeat.

1020-2604-2866-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Myr Retriever, adding one mana of any color.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Scrap Trawler by paying its mana cost, which is reduced by Ugin, the Ineffable.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Scrap Trawler, adding one mana of any color.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Retriever by paying its mana cost, which is reduced by Ugin, the Ineffable.
Repeat.

30-141-413.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
30-141-413.description:
Cast Storm of Souls by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it and Blasting Station trigger, with Naru Meha targeting Storm of Souls.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Storm of Souls.
Resolve the Storm of Souls copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
30-141-413.notes: You can return any amount of creature cards with Storm of Souls as desired.

2438-5220-5332-6900.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing it.
When Carrion Feeder dies, Mortuary and Carmen trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Carrion Feeder from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Carmen trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Carmen.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Cast Carrion Feeder from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

1987-2103-4423-6927.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Islands.
1987-2103-4423-6927.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Damage Control Crew.
When Damage Control Crew and Mystic Sanctuary enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Damage Control Crew trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Capture of Jingzhou during your draw step.
Repeat.

132-2816-4851.description:
Activate Myr Welder using Timeless Lotus's ability by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Myr Welder by paying {3} and untapping it, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.

2335-4613-6702.description:
Activate Kilo using Barrenton Medic's first ability by tapping it.
Kilo triggers, causing you to proliferate and put a +1/+1 counter on Kilo.
Resolve the Kilo ability from step 1.
Activate Kilo using Barrenton Medic's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat.
2335-4613-6702.notes: If you have other creature(s) with tap abilities exiled by Agatha's Soul Cauldron, or have other ways to tap Kilo, you can use those instead in step 1. This combo will infinitely proliferate on all permanents you control except Kilo.

1323-4687-5711.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 4 or greater.
1323-4687-5711.description:
Activate Experiment Kraj using Fanatic of Rhonas's ability by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Experiment Kraj using Gilder Bairn's ability by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on target permanent.
Repeat.

813-957-5530.description:
Cast Time Stretch by paying its mana cost, taking two extra turns.
Cast Another Round by paying its mana cost, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Stretch and Another Round from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each other turn.
813-957-5530.notes: If desired, you can do steps 2 and 3 during the first extra turn instead to spread out the mana costs.

116-3734-5329.notablePrerequisites:
Phyrexian Metamorph on the battlefield as a copy of Kiora's Follower.
Kiora's Follower and Phyrexian Metamorph do not have summoning sickness.
116-3734-5329.description:
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, targeting Phyrexian Metamorph.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Kiora's Follower ability, untapping Phyrexian Metamorph.
Activate Phyrexian Metamorph by tapping it, targeting Kiora's Follower.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Phyrexian Metamorph ability, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Repeat.

2608-5470.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to create a token copy of Derevi.
2608-5470.description:
Create a token copy of Derevi.
Put the nontoken Derevi into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Activate Ghired by tapping it, creating a token copy of the Derevi copy.
Put either Derevi into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Derevi token enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Ghired.
Repeat from step 3.

678-2511-4766.easyPrerequisites: Deathrender attached to a nontoken creature you control.
678-2511-4766.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the creature with Deathrender attached.
When the creature dies, Enduring Renewal and Deathrender trigger.
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Deathrender trigger, putting the creature from your hand onto the battlefield, and attaching Deathrender to it.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

2178-3143-3490-3800.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature with one or more +1/+1 counters on it.
You control at least one other creature.
Iceberg has at least one ice counter on it.
Thornbite Staff attached to Xavier Sal.
Xavier Sal does not have summoning sickness.
2178-3143-3490-3800.description:
Activate Xavier Sal's second ability by tapping it and sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Xavier Sal triggers, untapping Xavier Sal.
Resolve the Xavier Sal ability from step 1, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control and an ice counter on Iceberg.
Animation Module triggers, holding priority, activate Iceberg's second ability by removing an ice counter from it, adding {C}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite +1/+1 counters among creatures you control, you may instead use Xavier Sal's first ability to get infinite copies of creature tokens you control.

2438-3605-5145.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Archon of Falling Stars.
When Archon of Falling Stars dies, it triggers, returning Dance of the Dead from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Dance of the Dead enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Archon of Falling Stars from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attaching Dance of the Dead to it.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1722-1950-2444-3000-3297.notablePrerequisites:
You control a non-Squirrel creature that has power 3 or greater.
There are at least two Tentacles on the battlefield.
1722-1950-2444-3000-3297.description:
Cast Henry Wu by paying {B}{G}{U}.
When Henry Wu enters the battlefield, its exploit ability triggers.
Holding priority, cast Artificial Evolution by paying {U}, changing all instances of "Human" on Henry Wu to "Squirrel".
Resolve the Henry Wu trigger, causing you to sacrifice another non-Squirrel creature with power 3 or greater.
Henry Wu's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card and create a 1/1 Squirrel creature token and a Treasure artifact token.
The Squirrel's exploit ability and Nadir Kraken trigger.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Nadir Kraken trigger, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on it and create a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Resolve the Squirrel trigger from step 6, causing you to sacrifice the Tentacle.
Repeat from step 5.

962-2816-3099.notablePrerequisites:
Umbral Mantle attached to Yurlok of Scorch Thrash.
Yurlok of Scorch Thrash does not have summoning sickness.
962-2816-3099.description:
Activate Yurlok of Scorch Thrash by paying {1} and tapping it, causing you to add {B}{R}{G}{G} and each opponent to add {B}{R}{G}.
Activate Yurlok of Scorch Thrash by paying {3} and untapping it, causing itself to get +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat an arbitrarily large amount of times.
Move to your next step or phase, causing each opponent to lose life equal to the amount of unspent mana in their mana pool.

528-3644-4050-5189.notablePrerequisites: Young Wolf does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
528-3644-4050-5189.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Young Wolf, adding {1}.
Young Wolf's undying triggers, returning Young Wolf from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Young Wolf enters the battlefield triggering Corpse Knight, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Activate Ghave's second ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from Young Wolf, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
The Saproling token enters the battlefield triggering Corpse Knight, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

618-2792-2821.notablePrerequisites: You control an additional land that can produce {U}.
618-2792-2821.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Great Whale with haste that will be sacrificed at the beginning of the next end step.
The token Great Whale enters the battlefield, triggering itself, untapping Minamo and up to six other lands.
Activate those other lands by tapping them, adding at least {U}.
Activate Minamo's last ability by paying {U} and tapping it, untapping Kiki-Jiki.
Repeat.
